dateRange.description: A date range condition. The 'type' field is the discriminator.

endAt.description: Absolute end datetime (ISO 8601). Omit for open-ended. Applies when type='absolute'.

endDay.description: End day of month (1-31). Required when type='annual'.

startAt.description: Absolute start datetime (ISO 8601). Required when type='absolute'.

startDay.description: Start day of month (1-31). Required when type='annual'.

type.description: Kind of date range. 'annual' recurs every year; 'absolute' is a one-time range.

geoContext.description: Geographic and timezone context used for schedule evaluation and solar event calculation.

location.description: WGS84 geographic location. Required for sunrise/sunset/solar-noon time references.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g. 'Asia/Tokyo'). Required for timeWindow and daysOfWeek schedule evaluation.

avatars.description: Backward-compatible flat list of avatar items. Used as an always-active default when schedules is absent.

enabled.description: Whether avatar rotation feature is enabled.

fallbackAvatarId.description: TID of the avatar to display when no schedule matches the current time. Omit to skip rotation when no schedule is active.

geoContext.description: Geographic and timezone context for schedule evaluation. Required when any schedule uses time-based or solar schedules.

interval.description: The interval at which avatar rotation should occur.

mode.description: The default rotation mode used when a schedule does not specify its own mode.

rotationList.description: An ordered list of avatar items with optional rotation mode and interval overrides.

interval.description: Rotation interval override for this list. Falls back to the top-level settings.interval when absent. Not applicable to TimeWindow lists (which use one-shot execution at window boundaries).

mode.description: Rotation mode override. Falls back to the top-level settings.mode when absent.

rotationSchedule.description: A named rotation schedule with an optional activation condition.

id.description: TID-format unique identifier for this schedule.

kind.description: Schedule kind. 'default' is always active. 'period' uses date/day-of-week timing. 'timed' uses time-of-day windows.

timing.description: Activation timing for 'period' kind. Omit to make always active within the period kind.

windows.description: Time-of-day windows for 'timed' kind. The schedule is active when the current time falls within any window.

timeReference.description: A time reference for schedule boundaries. The 'type' field is the discriminator.

offsetMin.description: Offset in minutes from the solar event. Negative values are before the event. Applies to sunrise/sunset/solar-noon.

time.description: Wall-clock time in 'HH:MM' format interpreted in geoContext.timezone. Required when type='fixed'.

type.description: Kind of time reference. 'fixed' requires the 'time' field; solar types use geoContext.location.

timeWindow.description: A time window defined by start and end time references, with its own avatar list.

end.description: Window end time reference. Omit for open-ended windows.

timing.description: Activation timing for a period schedule. All fields are optional; specified conditions are evaluated with AND semantics.

daysOfWeek.description: Active days of week. Omit to match all days.

ttlSec.description: Seconds after dateRange.endAt before automatically reverting to the next active schedule.
